citations.claim: Reporting requires Pro, Business, or Enterprise; the Viewer role cannot open Reporting; after a Starter to Pro upgrade, existing users keep the Viewer role and an Admin must change them to Analyst in Settings → Users & Roles; signing out or clearing the cache does not fix a missing permission.
Upgrading a plan does not change existing users' roles, so non-admin users remain Viewers until an Admin changes their role to Analyst.
The Analyst and Admin roles include Reporting permission; the Viewer role never includes Reporting on any plan.

observed.draft_reply:
Hello Maya,

Thanks for reaching out. Your account is on the Pro plan, which includes Reporting. Upgrading the plan does not change existing users' roles, so users who were Viewers before the upgrade still have the Viewer role. The Viewer role cannot open Reporting on any plan, and signing out or clearing the cache does not change permissions.

To fix this, an Admin can go to Settings → Users & Roles and change the affected users' role from Viewer to Analyst. Admins on your account (you or Aisha Rahman) can make this change.

To confirm which two employees are affected, could you send us their names or email addresses? Several other non-admin users on your account are also Viewers, so we want to make sure we update the right accounts. If the change is made and they still cannot access Reporting, reply to this message and we will look into it further.

Northstar Support
